en: ⟦D01.legal_operator⟧ uses your email and password to create and secure your Kinnso account and provide sign-in and recovery. Both are required; without them we cannot create the account. Read Privacy information for data sharing and your access and correction rights, or contact ⟦D01.privacy_owner_and_contact⟧. Creating an account does not publish a profile or guide.
zh_HK: ⟦D01.legal_operator⟧ 會使用你的電郵及密碼建立和保護 Kinnso 帳戶，並提供登入及帳戶復原。這兩項資料屬必填；欠缺資料便無法建立帳戶。資料披露安排及查閱、更正權利詳見「私隱資訊」，亦可聯絡 ⟦D01.privacy_owner_and_contact⟧。建立帳戶不會發布個人檔案或攻略。
proposed_surface: Notice before existing Create account button; existing legal/privacy link
dependencies: D01; P02-P08 accessible before collection
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-TARGET; no blanket consent or new fields

en: Kinnso is operated by ⟦D01.legal_operator⟧. When you use an available account service, we handle the information needed for that service: account details; saved trips, notes and photos; creator profile details, submitted source links and guide drafts; company and collaboration records; and support subjects and messages. We use these to provide account access, save your work, publish content you explicitly approve, manage collaborations, and investigate and reply to enquiries. Optional measurement is described separately below.
zh_HK: Kinnso 由 ⟦D01.legal_operator⟧ 營運。當你使用已提供的帳戶服務時，我們會處理該項服務所需的資料，包括帳戶資料；已保存的行程、筆記及照片；創作者檔案、你提交的來源連結及攻略草稿；公司及合作紀錄；以及支援案件的主題和訊息。用途包括提供帳戶存取、保存你的工作、發布經你明確確認的內容、管理合作，以及查核和回覆查詢。自選量測另於下文說明。
proposed_surface: Opening PPS paragraphs replacing incomplete-policy notice only after approval
dependencies: D01; D03 data inventory and purposes; actual enabled services
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-TARGET

en: An email address, password and matching password confirmation are required for signup. A subject and message are required to submit a support case; without them that request cannot be submitted. Give only what is needed for the issue. You choose whether to add private notes or photos, publish or share content, or allow optional measurement. You can browse published guides without creating an account.
zh_HK: 註冊時必須提供電郵、密碼及一致的確認密碼。提交支援案件則必須填寫主題及訊息，否則無法送出該項要求。請只提供處理問題所需的資料。是否加入私人筆記或照片、發布或分享內容，以及允許自選量測，均由你選擇。毋須建立帳戶亦可瀏覽已發布攻略。
proposed_surface: General collection notice; link from existing signup and support forms before submission
dependencies: D01; P04-P08; S02 where collaboration context exists
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-SUPPORT; G-TARGET; no new collection form

en: Visitors can read your published guide content and public author details. Your private trip records are separate. Collaboration material is visible according to the creator's and company's authorised roles. You and authorised support staff can follow your support case. Opening a case does not give everyone access to private delivery evidence or publish that evidence. External service recipients and any other disclosures are specified in the service description below.
zh_HK: 訪客可閱讀你已發布的攻略內容及公開作者資料；私人行程紀錄另行保存。合作資料按創作者及公司獲授權角色的權限顯示。你與獲授權客服人員可跟進你的支援案件。建立案件不會讓所有人取得私人交付證明的權限，亦不會公開該等證明。外部服務接收者及其他資料披露安排，列於下方服務說明。
proposed_surface: Audience and disclosure paragraph
dependencies: D01; D03; existing company/ops/private-proof permissions
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-TARGET; verify role boundaries; never widen proof access

en: Account and company permissions control access to private workspaces. The activated services, recipient classes, purposes, data received, processing locations and safeguards are: ⟦D03.active_processing⟧. Any additional uses involving AI analysis, model training or direct marketing, and the applicable notices and choices, are: ⟦D03.secondary_uses⟧. Creating an account or allowing optional measurement is not consent to an unrelated use of your personal data.
zh_HK: 私人工作區的存取受帳戶及公司權限控制。實際啟用的服務、接收者類別、用途、接收資料、處理地點及保障措施如下：⟦D03.active_processing⟧。任何涉及 AI 分析、模型訓練或直接促銷的額外用途，以及適用通知和選擇如下：⟦D03.secondary_uses⟧。建立帳戶或允許自選量測，並不等於同意將個人資料用於不相關的新用途。
proposed_surface: Concrete service/processor disclosures within PPS
dependencies: D01; D03 actual configuration, contracts, logs and secondary-use evidence
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-TARGET; no vendor/region or no-training/no-marketing claim from architecture alone

en: Personal data should not be kept longer than necessary for its stated purposes, subject to applicable legal requirements. Our approved retention, deletion and backup arrangements are: ⟦D03.retention_and_backups⟧. To ask about removal of an account or content, use the privacy contact below. We will explain what can be removed, any necessary retained records and the reason, and how backup copies are handled. Signing out or clearing browser storage does not itself erase account records; a removal request is not confirmation of completed deletion.
zh_HK: 除適用法律要求外，個人資料不應保留超過達到原定用途所需的時間。經核准的保留、刪除及備份安排如下：⟦D03.retention_and_backups⟧。如欲要求移除帳戶或內容，請使用下方私隱聯絡方式。我們會說明可移除的資料、仍有必要保留的紀錄及原因，以及備份副本的處理方法。登出或清除瀏覽器儲存不會直接刪除帳戶紀錄；提出移除要求亦不代表已完成刪除。
proposed_surface: PPS retention paragraph; explanatory link from existing account page only
dependencies: D01; D03 class-specific criteria, processor deletion, backup rotation/restoration handling and lawful exceptions
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-TARGET; no new deletion control or invented completion period

en: You can ask whether we hold personal data about you, request a copy, and ask us to correct inaccurate data. Contact ⟦D01.privacy_owner_and_contact⟧ and describe the records concerned. We may need limited information to verify your identity or authority before disclosing data. Do not post identity documents, passwords or sign-in codes in public pages or demo workspaces. Any fee for a data access request must not be excessive and will be explained before supply.
zh_HK: 你可查詢我們是否持有你的個人資料、要求取得副本，以及要求更正不準確的資料。請聯絡 ⟦D01.privacy_owner_and_contact⟧，並說明涉及的紀錄。在披露資料前，我們可能需要有限資料以核實你的身份或授權。請勿在公開頁面或示範工作區張貼身份證明、密碼或登入驗證碼。查閱資料要求如涉及費用，費用不得超乎適度，並會在提供資料前說明。
proposed_surface: Rights contact paragraph; same verified destination from existing contact entry
dependencies: D01 accountable role and published contact; D02 routing; D03 fee decision if applicable
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-SUPPORT; approved-channel receipt drill separately authorised; no placeholder destination

en: The Hong Kong Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance generally requires compliance with a data access request, or correction of data found inaccurate and supply of the corrected copy, within 40 calendar days of receiving the request. If full compliance is not possible within that period, written reasons and any compliance possible are due within it; the remainder must follow as soon as practicable. Refusals must also be notified with reasons within 40 days, subject to statutory exceptions. These are statutory requirements, separate from ordinary support response targets.
zh_HK: 香港《個人資料（私隱）條例》一般規定，須在收到要求後 40 個曆日內依從查閱資料要求，或更正經確認不準確的資料並提供更正後的副本。如未能在該期限內全部依從，須在期限內書面說明原因，並依從當時能夠依從的部分，其餘須在切實可行範圍內盡快完成。拒絕要求亦須在 40 日內通知並說明原因，但法定例外情況除外。這些屬法定要求，與一般支援回覆目標分開處理。
proposed_surface: Rights timing paragraph beside P07
dependencies: D01 legal/privacy review; PCPD L03/L04; statutory receipt/deadline log
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-SUPPORT; no working-day substitution or blanket clock restart

en: Connected account services can save information beyond this browser. Where device recovery is available, unsent drafts may also be kept on this device for the relevant account. Demo pages use sample data and local browser storage; a demo identity grants no account, company or operations access. Clearing local storage is separate from deleting account data. Keep private evidence out of demo pages.
zh_HK: 已接通的帳戶服務可將資料保存於這個瀏覽器以外。如裝置恢復功能可用，未送出的草稿亦可能按相關帳戶保存在此裝置。示範頁使用樣本資料及瀏覽器本機儲存；示範身份不會授予帳戶、公司或營運權限。清除本機儲存與刪除帳戶資料是兩回事。請勿在示範頁提供私人證明。
proposed_surface: Account/device explanation retaining existing demo boundary
dependencies: D03 device and server retention; recovery availability
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-TARGET

en: When you explicitly publish a guide, its published content and public author details can be read by visitors. Saving a private draft is separate from publishing. Check the saved guide content before choosing Publish structured version. Publishing a later version does not rewrite travellers' existing private copies. Publication is not permission to reuse someone else's text or images.
zh_HK: 當你明確發布攻略後，訪客便可閱讀已發布內容及公開作者資料。保存私人草稿與發布是兩回事。選取「發布結構化版本」前，請先核對已保存的攻略內容。發布較新版本不會改寫旅客已有的私人副本。發布操作本身並不授予你重用他人文字或圖片的權利。
proposed_surface: Paragraph before existing Publish structured version action
dependencies: D01 content-use approval; real author consent and image rights
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-CONTENT remains BLOCKED; G-TARGET; explicit action only

en: Your private trip notes and photos are separate from published author content. A photo you select for a read-only share becomes visible through that link. Check the selected photos and public fields before sharing; do not include personal information or images you are not entitled to disclose. A private upload is not permission to publish it.
zh_HK: 私人行程筆記及照片與作者已發布內容分開。你選取作唯讀分享的照片，會透過該連結供人查看。分享前請核對所選照片及公開欄位，勿加入你無權披露的個人資料或圖片。私人上載並不等於獲准公開。
proposed_surface: Existing private photo area and share-selection notice
dependencies: D01; media/sharing capability and existing projection; selected-photo rights
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-TARGET; G-CONTENT for real content; no universal metadata-stripping claim

en: Anyone holding an active read-only link can view the selected titles and photos. Check the displayed expiry and share the link only with people you intend to receive it. Private notes, receipts and account information are excluded from that view. A confirmed revocation stops new access through that link; expiry or revocation cannot recall downloaded copies or erase other account records.
zh_HK: 任何持有有效唯讀連結的人均可查看所選名稱及照片。請核對顯示的到期時間，並只把連結交給你打算分享的對象。該畫面不包括私人筆記、收據及帳戶資料。確認撤銷後，便不能再透過該連結取得新存取；但到期或撤銷均不能收回已下載副本，亦不會刪除其他帳戶紀錄。
proposed_surface: Replace existing share explanation; expiry remains from actual link metadata
dependencies: D01; actual sharing expiry and revocation; selected projection
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-TARGET; confirmed revocation/readback only; expiry is not retention

en: Before publishing or sharing, check that you own or have appropriate permission for the text and photos, and any consent needed for identifiable people. Keep the permission record privately. Attribution, a public URL, collaboration acceptance or a completed readiness checklist does not establish those rights. If permission is uncertain, keep the content as a private draft.
zh_HK: 發布或分享前，請確認你擁有文字及照片的權利，或已取得適當授權，並已取得可識別人士所需的同意。請私下保存授權紀錄。註明來源、提供公開網址、獲接納參與合作或完成發布條件檢查，都不能證明你已取得相關權利。如授權未明，請保留為私人草稿。
proposed_surface: Existing publication/readiness and sharing notice; no new consent form
dependencies: D01 approved permission scope; private consent/licence references
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-CONTENT remains BLOCKED until real evidence is reviewed; copy is not consent

en: Author content stays in the language supplied; changing the interface language does not automatically translate it. A publication date is not a place-verification date. Missing opening hours, prices, source language or verification dates remain unknown. Check the original source and current provider information before relying on a guide; a saved guide is not a booking or availability guarantee.
zh_HK: 作者內容保留提交時的語言；切換介面語言不會自動翻譯內容。發布日期並不等於地點查核日期。欠缺的營業時間、價格、原文語言或查核日期仍屬未知。採用攻略前，請核對原始來源及服務提供者的最新資訊；保存攻略不代表已訂位或保證供應。
proposed_surface: Guide quality/provenance explanation; supplied author language retained
dependencies: D01 editorial approval; source provenance facts
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-CONTENT for real guide; do not backfill missing facts

en: For general help, use ⟦D02.support_channel⟧. Support is staffed ⟦D02.support_hours⟧, in Hong Kong time. When account support is available, you can open or follow a case in Your support cases. A saved case does not mean a staff member has read it. Privacy access and correction requests should use the privacy contact in Privacy information; their statutory deadlines are separate.
zh_HK: 一般查詢請使用 ⟦D02.support_channel⟧。支援當值時段為香港時間 ⟦D02.support_hours⟧。帳戶支援可用時，你可在「你的客服案件」建立或跟進案件。案件已保存並不代表客服人員已閱讀。查閱及更正個人資料的要求，請使用「私隱資訊」內的私隱聯絡方式；相關法定期限另行計算。
proposed_surface: General support/contact paragraphs on existing entries
dependencies: D01; D02 verified destination, accountable staffing and coverage
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-SUPPORT; no unstaffed SLA or unverified message destination

en: We use the collaboration name and reference, together with the subject and message you send, to understand and follow up this enquiry. Include only details needed for the issue. Your case does not publish delivery evidence or change who may view it. Collaboration review, payment and refund decisions remain separate from support handling.
zh_HK: 我們會使用合作名稱及參考編號，以及你送出的主題和訊息，了解和跟進這次查詢。請只加入處理問題所需的資料。建立案件不會公開交付證明，亦不會改變可查看證明的人士。合作審核、付款及退款決定，均與支援案件的處理分開。
proposed_surface: By existing Ask support about this collaboration link and before context-linked case submission
dependencies: D01; D02; server-authorised collaboration context; existing private-proof permissions
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-SUPPORT; G-TARGET; no automatic evidence attachment or broader proof access

en: Support requests are not connected here yet. Signing in cannot enable this service. You can still browse published guides or check the workspace directory. For an existing booking, use the provider and reference on your original confirmation. This site does not accept bookings or payments.
zh_HK: 支援要求服務尚未接通，登入亦不能啟用這項服務。你仍可瀏覽已發布攻略，或查看工作區導覽。已有訂位請按原有確認，向相關服務提供者查詢並提供參考編號。本網站目前不接受訂位或付款。
proposed_surface: Existing service-disabled state and booking help exit
dependencies: Existing capability branch and booking boundary; D01/D02 review
activation_gate: G-POLICY; disabled state only; no login loop or new intake destination

en: This draft is kept on this device for this account. It is not confirmation that support has received it. Keep your unsent text until you see a confirmed case or reply in your account.
zh_HK: 這份草稿已按此帳戶保存在這個裝置。這不代表客服已收到內容。在帳戶內看到案件或回覆已確認保存前，請保留未送出的文字。
proposed_surface: Existing device-draft status
dependencies: Successful account-scoped device recovery save
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-RECOVERY; saved-draft signal only; never use as case acknowledgement

en: We could not confirm whether your request was saved. Keep this page open and retain your text. Use Retry the same request to check the original attempt. Do not create a new case or send a second copy while its outcome is unclear. If you need help, refer to the original case if one is already shown.
zh_HK: 我們未能確認這次要求是否已保存。請保持本頁開啟並保留文字，使用「重試相同請求」核對原來的提交。結果未明前，請勿另建案件或再送一份。如需協助，若畫面已有原案件編號，請沿用該編號跟進。
proposed_surface: Existing uncertain-submit/retry state
dependencies: Preserve original requestId, command/payload, case identity and scope; receipt-first recovery
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-RECOVERY; no new request ID, resubmission payload or success claim while unknown

en: Your request has been recorded as {{case_reference}}. You can follow it in Your support cases. This confirms the case was saved; it does not confirm that a staff member has reviewed it.
zh_HK: 你的要求已記錄為 {{case_reference}}，可在「你的客服案件」跟進。這只確認案件已保存，並不代表客服人員已審閱。
proposed_surface: Existing confirmed-case status; customer acknowledgement template
dependencies: Confirmed create receipt and correct account/case readback; actual case reference
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-SUPPORT; G-RECOVERY; never show after timeout, click, draft save or unconfirmed mail delivery

en: Your reply has been recorded in case {{case_reference}}. It is available in that case's conversation. This confirms the reply was saved; review by support is separate.
zh_HK: 你的回覆已記錄於案件 {{case_reference}}，可在該案件對話查看。這只確認回覆已保存；客服審閱屬另一個步驟。
proposed_surface: Existing confirmed-reply status; use real case reference rather than generic updated marker
dependencies: Confirmed original reply receipt and same-case message readback
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-SUPPORT; G-RECOVERY; never infer staff read or external delivery

en: This case has changed. Reload to read its latest replies and status, then review your saved draft before sending. Reloading the case is not confirmation that an earlier attempt was received. If that attempt is still uncertain, use Retry the same request.
zh_HK: 這個案件已有變動。請重新載入查看最新回覆及狀態，再核對保留的草稿才提交。重新載入案件並不代表較早的提交已收到。如該次提交結果仍未明，請使用「重試相同請求」。
proposed_surface: Existing conflict explanation
dependencies: Current case readback; retain unsent case-specific draft and pending identity
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-RECOVERY; no blind overwrite or new-ID retry

en: For case {{case_reference}}, please provide {{requested_detail}} so we can {{why_needed}}. Reply in this case and include only the requested information. Do not send your password or sign-in codes. We will review the additional information before confirming a next step.
zh_HK: 就案件 {{case_reference}}，請提供 {{requested_detail}}，以便我們 {{why_needed}}。請在本案件內回覆，並只提供所要求的資料，切勿提交密碼或登入驗證碼。我們會先查核補充資料，再確認下一步。
proposed_surface: Human reply template for existing waiting_customer transition
dependencies: D02 assigned staff; necessary and proportionate detail; reason remains internal
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-SUPPORT; authorised confirmed case only; no automatic send

en: For case {{case_reference}}, we have completed {{verified_action}}. {{remaining_action_or_no_further_action}}. We are closing this support case on that basis. This does not itself approve a collaboration, change financial records, make a payment or promise a refund.
zh_HK: 就案件 {{case_reference}}，我們已完成 {{verified_action}}。{{remaining_action_or_no_further_action}}。我們會按上述結果結束這個支援案件。這項結案本身不會核准合作、更改財務紀錄、安排付款或承諾退款。
proposed_surface: Human reply template for existing resolved transition
dependencies: D02; verified action and customer-visible result; separate internal decision reason
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-SUPPORT; no automatic closure, financial promise or send

en: Allow optional activity counts and page experience measurements to help us understand use and improve performance? These measurements use random or pseudonymous identifiers and exclude private trip text and messages. You can decline or later change this choice in Measurement preference. This preference covers these optional measurements; account, recovery and service operation records are handled separately. See Privacy information for the approved service, data-use and retention details.
zh_HK: 是否允許自選的活動次數及頁面體驗量測，協助我們了解使用情況和改善效能？這些量測使用隨機或假名識別碼，不包括私人行程文字及訊息。你可拒絕，或稍後在「量測選擇」更改決定。此選擇適用於上述自選量測；帳戶、恢復及服務運作紀錄另行處理。經核准的服務、資料用途及保留安排詳見「私隱資訊」。
existing_route: Connected non-ops pages where TelemetryConsent is mounted
proposed_surface: Replace existing optional measurement paragraph; retain existing Allow/Decline controls
dependencies: D01; D03 actual activation/providers/retention; required vs optional processing disclosed
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-MEASURE; G-TARGET; no blanket anonymity, opt-in-for-all-logs or marketing consent

en: Optional measurement is off in this browser. This does not delete measurements already collected or change another device's choice. Contact the privacy owner in Privacy information if you want to ask about existing records.
zh_HK: 這個瀏覽器已關閉自選量測。這不會刪除先前已收集的量測紀錄，亦不會更改其他裝置的選擇。如欲查詢已有紀錄，請按「私隱資訊」聯絡私隱負責人。
existing_route: Connected non-ops pages where TelemetryConsent is mounted
proposed_surface: Proposed success wording for confirmed decline; current local state alone is insufficient
dependencies: D03; matching local denial plus confirmed server consent response
activation_gate: G-POLICY; G-MEASURE; do not display definitive server-state success on fetch failure

en: We received your privacy request on {{received_at_HKT}}. Your reference is {{case_reference}}. This acknowledges receipt only. We will assess the request and, if necessary, ask for limited information to confirm identity, authority or the records concerned. The receipt date and applicable statutory deadline will be recorded separately from support response targets.
zh_HK: 我們已於香港時間 {{received_at_HKT}} 收到你的私隱要求，參考編號為 {{case_reference}}。本訊息只確認收妥。我們會評估要求，並在有需要時索取有限資料，以核實身份、授權或涉及的紀錄。收件日期及適用法定期限會另行記錄，不會以一般支援回覆目標代替。
existing_route: Manual reply through D01 approved privacy contact; not a new route
